decisions.evidence: Definition reviewed against the published hierarchy, Def and set-satisfaction suppliers. Verified: only nonzero limit levels are in the domain so the empty set supplies the fixed default; the least-witness graphs are sets by Separation using the canonical L-order, so each f_i is a function and no arbitrary family of choices is used; parameter-free formulas enter at H_1, so the hull of the empty seed is nonempty; the enumeration with unused parameters and k_i=0 matches the published Def convention; the full-ZF tuple-satisfaction hypothesis is explicitly not asserted of the level. Sound; no defect.

Sound. Re-derived set existence of the stage sequence (Replacement on the joint evaluation relation plus Union), the term representation of hull elements, the Tarski-Vaught elementarity argument (closure under the least-witness functions supplies the witness; H nonempty covers the existential test), and the cardinal bound: one fixed kappa x kappa bijection with length coding injects all valid terms, and hence H, into |A|. Checked A=empty and finite A (the successor-defining formula forces omega into H and the omega bound makes H countably infinite) and infinite A (A subset H gives |H|=|A|). No AC; no defect.

Sound. Read every step of this custom supplier: the total Enum/Decode absoluteness in transitive carriers containing HF; the two-branch Decode with the exact Def(empty)={empty} clause and unused parameters; the fixed finite level overhead for assignment graphs, exact assignment sets and truth tables; L_omega=V_omega with no Infinity and the fixed sentence C in every nonzero limit level; the external induction making internal Hist witnesses actual; the hierarchy and augmented-order histories with their stated finite L-level bounds (rank computations confirm them, with slack); and the converse that any nonempty transitive model of C is L_beta, beta=N cap Ord, via actuality plus level exhaustion. The limit-stage prefix is legitimately a subset of L_lambda because delta+3<lambda for delta<lambda. No false step found; no defect.

Sound. L_alpha satisfies the fixed finite sentence C, elementarity transfers it to X, and the Mostowski isomorphism transfers it to the transitive set M, which is nonempty and therefore equals L_beta with beta=M cap Ord by the supplier's converse; the alpha=omega boundary is covered by the supplier's separate L_omega=V_omega clause. The fixing and ordinal-image conclusions are exactly the cited collapse lemma, and no full-ZF absoluteness is applied to the collapsed level. No defect.

Sound. The finite-description-tree encoding is well founded: labels (gamma,i) with gamma<alpha and a formula code, ordered children for parameters, uniqueness of the evaluated value by uniqueness of satisfaction, and existence of a valid tree for each x by induction on the constructible rank using only finite existential choices. Encoding node labels, punctuation, length and the iterated pairing with one alpha->kappa bijection injects the trees, hence L_alpha, into kappa=|alpha|; alpha<=|L_alpha| is by inclusion. Checked alpha=omega and uniform successor/limit handling. No AC; no defect.

Sound. The upper bound injects formula/finite-tuple codes into kappa=|alpha| using the level bijection and one Hessenberg pairing and assigns least codes to definable subsets, with empty tuples included; the lower bound uses transitivity: for a in L_alpha the parameterized formula x in a defines a over L_alpha, so L_alpha is contained in Def(L_alpha). Both sides are well-orderable and |Def(L_alpha)|=kappa. No AC; no defect.

Sound. Checked both seeds (kappa cup {kappa,x}, and L_kappa cup {L_kappa,kappa,x} of size kappa by the level-cardinality lemma), hull elementarity with |H|=kappa, collapse to M=L_beta, beta<kappa^+ because beta=N cap Ord injects into M and hence into kappa, and the fixing of kappa (respectively the transitive L_kappa) which makes pi(x)={pi(xi):xi in x}=x for x subseteq kappa (respectively L_kappa). The empty-set boundary holds and the successor is the Hartogs successor, so no ambient Choice is used. No defect.

Sound. Inside L every subset p of an infinite cardinal kappa is constructible, so the internal instance of the stage-bound theorem places p in L_lambda with lambda=(kappa^+)^L; internal level cardinality gives (2^kappa)^L<=lambda, and Cantor's inequality under internal AC plus minimality of the successor cardinal gives lambda<=(2^kappa)^L. The final V=L clause identifies internal and ambient cardinals. AC is spent only inside L and no ambient power-set well-ordering is claimed. No defect.

Sound. The construction is the standard least-counterexample argument: S_delta is the chi-least B admitting a club D subset delta with S_xi not equal B cap xi on D; the least global failure pair is defined by bounded club and failure clauses and L_theta is a <_L initial segment, so L_theta sees its minimality; the canonical hull contains the seed and X cap omega_1 is an ordinal (the hull is closed under the definable successor and definable witnesses, so omega subset X and every zeta in X cap omega_1 has all predecessors in X), giving a nonzero countable limit delta with delta in C by closure; the collapse computes pi(S)=S restricted to delta, pi(A)=A cap delta and pi(C)=C cap delta; internal leastness plus the initial-segment property forces S_delta=A cap delta, contradicting the club condition. Stationarity, not mere unboundedness, is proved. No defect.

Sound. Applies the authored diamond theorem and the published diamond-to-Suslin construction; V=L supplies ambient AC through thm-constructible-universe-satisfies-choice, exactly the hypothesis the tree construction consumes (countable unions, maximal antichains, deterministic well-ordering). No degenerate height is asserted and stationary guessing is not weakened to unbounded guessing. No defect.

Sound as the stated conditional metatheorem. Checked the fixed presentation (D(x) expanded into membership syntax; AC and GCH as literal tags), the eight-block axiom dispatcher, the Separation block (subformula-closure witness ranks, ambient Separation, Decode/Def step) and the Replacement block (ambient Replacement on the D-guarded functional matrix, constructible-rank bound, then the Separation block on the original image matrix). Step 4.1 formalizes only bounded list operations, structural recursion, capture-free substitution and line-prefix induction, with a fixed malformed-input default, and its PA claim is conditional on the published effective-interpretation/proof-translation interface that I reread. No defect.

Sound. The map r composes the preceding lemma's primitive-recursive translator with the fixed contradiction block; PA proves totality and the implication from target refutations to ZF refutations, and the published verified-reduction theorem converts this into the displayed Con implication. Only numerical proof codes occur; no set model, well-founded model or CTM of ZF is constructed or assumed. Consistent with the conditional boundary carried by its supplier. No defect.

Sound. CH is a fixed finite consequence of the selected GCH sentence (the aleph_0 instance), so appending that derivation gives a primitive-recursive map from ZFC+CH refutations to ZFC+GCH refutations and Con(ZFC+GCH) implies Con(ZFC+CH); the ZF-to-ZFC line-identity map gives Con(ZFC) implies Con(ZF). Composing with the preceding theorem yields both positive statements. No defect.

Sound. For a constructible real x, the hull of the countable seed omega cup {omega,x} is elementary and of size omega; the collapse fixes omega pointwise and gives pi(x)={pi(n):n in x}=x, so x lies in M=L_beta; beta=N cap Ord is a subset of M, so beta is countable and beta<omega_1. The empty-real case is included and the general successor-cardinal theorem is consistent with the sharper witness. No AC; no defect.

Sound as the explicitly conditional stage computation. Given a countable partial tree and a nonempty maximal antichain A, the cited sealing lemma supplies countably many covering branches meeting A and tops whose predecessor set is exactly a branch, so every later node with a unique height-delta predecessor lies above a member of A; a global antichain restricting to A therefore cannot gain members at or above delta. Checked the concrete 2^{<omega} instance (explicit injection of finite strings, maximality of {<0>,<1>}, countable eventually-zero branch family) and that only the conditional operation, not global diamond existence, is claimed. Choice enters only for countable-level bookkeeping. No defect.

Sound. The clauses are the standard common-extension subset test, the two-direction equality test and the dense membership test with incompatible coefficients handled by common extensions; expanded equality calls only on proper subnames, so the rank recursion is well founded; the empty-name behaviour is correct (vacuous subset clause, no membership witness); no largest condition is required and the relation is internal to a transitive ZF ground with no generics or Choice. No defect.

Sound. Verified the descendant-cone closure of the input names, the sorted-rank well-founded order on pairs, the E-value subsets formed by Separation from the expanded clauses, cone-independence and hence uniqueness of the recursion, and atomic absoluteness inside a transitive ZF M using the names/rank absoluteness supplier. The statement restricts itself to atomic absoluteness and makes no power-set comparison of name levels. No defect.

Sound. The three clauses (conjunction, negation, dense-witness existential) are written with name quantification restricted by the definable namehood predicate, so each fixed formula yields a first-order predicate. The definition states explicitly that this is a scheme per formula rather than a uniform truth predicate and that ground models interpret the clauses internally. No maximal-antichain selection and no AC. No defect.

Sound. Verified persistence and density closure clause by clause (atomic subset/equality/membership, conjunction, negation using reflexivity to contradict a hypothetical extension, existential via dense-below refinements), decision density, and the dense-below-p meeting set {q in D:q<=p} union {q:q incompatible with p} whose generic meeting avoids the incompatible part by directedness. The correct hypothesis p in G is used where the printed source's claim is imprecise. No defect.

Sound. Re-derived the forward equality direction (directedness, the dense equality-witness set, subname induction) and the converse bad-set argument: K_{sigma,tau} collects r with an entry whose subname cannot be matched, K_{sigma,tau} union K_{tau,sigma} union the equality conditions is dense, and no K meets G when sigma_G=tau_G, so G contains an equality condition. Membership in both directions and the negation/conjunction/existential steps follow with all ground sets in M. No AC and no generic-existence assumption. No defect.

Sound. The per-formula predicates are assembled from the atomic definability lemma with quantification restricted to the set P and the definable names; the truth-lemma direction needs no generic-existence assumption; and the all-generics display requires the extra supply of a generic through each condition, where a non-forcing p has q<=p forcing the negation and a generic through q contains p by upward closure. Scheme and existence boundaries are stated. No defect.

Sound. Checked the extension proof axiom by axiom: Empty Set and Infinity from M, Extensionality and Foundation by transitivity, Pairing via a pair name; Separation by the name cut out of dom(sigma)xP with a fixed internal forcing predicate; Union via descendant names plus Separation; Replacement via least witness-name ranks collected by internal Replacement and the name set U; Power Set via names in P(dom(sigma)xP)^M. The ZFC branch spends ground AC once (a bijection onto dom(sigma)) and then uses least fibres; no ambient Choice. No defect.

Sound. Ground ordinals return through check names; conversely gamma=tau_G satisfies rank(gamma)=gamma<=rk_P(tau), an ordinal of M, so gamma lies in M by transitivity (or directly when equal). Only preservation of ordinals as sets is claimed, with no cardinal, cofinality or enumeration conclusion. No defect.

Sound. Re-derived the refinement calculation (dense image plus compatibility reflection and order preservation give r<=p_1,...,p_n with e(r)<=q), the T and R recursions and the coefficient-closure form of T(R(tau)), the direct equality rules (reflexivity, symmetry, transitivity on sorted rank triples), equality preservation both ways on sorted rank pairs, the forced Q-equality T(R(tau))=tau proved entry by entry, membership transport, R(T(sigma))=sigma by equality reflection, the inverse generic correspondences (dense E', e^{-1}H=G, and the D_{p,s} density witness giving directedness), and both valuation identities. Checked the empty name, empty-preorder exclusion and removal of Boolean zero; no AC, BPI or inverse choice. No defect.

Sound. The separative quotient map is onto, hence of dense image, order-preserving and compatibility-preserving/reflecting; the regular-open map e(p)=int(cl(down p)) satisfies the containment and compatibility biconditionals with dense image in B minus {0}; the factored map is well defined and injective by antisymmetry of <=*; and an arbitrary dense order embedding has compatibility reflection from image density plus order reflection. All forcing conclusions pass through the authored dense-translation lemma, and Boolean zero is excluded. No defect.

Sound and correctly restricted. For a complete subalgebra inclusion B subset C, the pulled-back G=H cap B is directed (Boolean meets of members lie in H by upward closure), nonempty and upward closed; a ground dense D subset B+ has join 1, so its C-join is 1 and the set of nonzero C-conditions below a member of D is dense and meets H, giving genericity without maximal-antichain selection; the valuation of every B+-name by G equals its valuation by H by rank induction, giving M subset M[G] subset M[H]. The converse intermediate-model theorem is explicitly not asserted. No defect.

Sound. From external countability an injection is converted into a surjection with an empty fallback; the generic is built by least enumeration indices through the given condition; the forcing theorem gives the truth equivalence, the extension-axiom theorem gives ZFC and ordinal preservation gives equal ordinals; and external Separation/Replacement over the valuation map plus least preimages inject M[G] into omega, so the extension is externally countable. The theorem is conditional on the CTM and no CTM is inferred from consistency. No defect.

Sound. The retained data are finite: one Separation instance per witness-forcing predicate, one Replacement instance per least-witness-rank argument, finitely many syntax/rank/valuation absoluteness instances, Infinity and Extensionality, plus the supplied parameter and preorder proofs. Gamma is a finite ZFC list; the generic construction, valuation and truth arguments apply to any transitive Gamma-model; and no full-ZFC hypothesis is transferred to such a model. Ambient AC enters only through the published countable-model construction. No defect.

Sound as an explicitly conditional theorem. The bounded parser and support extraction are part of the stated B-verified constructors; the fragment construction supplies the source-model and conversion proofs; concatenation, variable renaming and the soundness constructor yield a ZFC refutation code r; and the published verified-reduction theorem converts the B-verified totality and correctness of r into the displayed Con implication. The statement refuses both unproved totality and external CTMs as substitutes, and no CTM of full ZFC is constructed. No defect.

Sound. With T=ZFC+phi the certified axioms split into ZFC tags and one extra tag identified by exact sentence-code equality; the finite support of a T-refutation is a finite ZFC list possibly with phi, and the assumed uniform verification supplies the constructors for exactly that list, including the case where phi is absent. The conditional transfer theorem then yields the display. A single CTM and its semantic extension are explicitly insufficient. No defect.

Sound. Equality is decided by subname induction on the sorted pair of ground ranks: if x=y the entry <check u,q> witnesses the clause, while a difference member u in x minus y gives the entry <check u,p> in x with no witness in y, so the subset clause fails; if both sets are empty the clauses are vacuous. Membership holds via the entry <check x,q> in check y when x in y and fails when x is not in y because every candidate differs from x. No generics or AC; no defect.

Sound. The singleton preorder has the unique generic G={1}; every dense set contains 1; valuation of arbitrary names is internal to M by rank induction and agrees with the external recursion, so M[G]=M; and the truth display specializes to the single condition, with check names recovering ground parameters. G in M is used only for this example and no Choice is used. No defect.

Sound. In the three-condition preorder 1 above unrelated atoms p and q, the witness set for check p in G-dot is exactly {p} (only the coefficient-p entry can qualify by the check-name equality computation), which is dense below p but not below 1 because q's only refinement is q; hence p forces membership and 1 does not. The example also notes that 1 cannot force the negation since p remains a refinement, and it does not contradict the correctly oriented persistence lemma. No defect.

Sound finite computation. The quotient classes are {1}, A={a,a'} and B={b} with a,a' mutually <=*-equivalent; the regular opens are exactly empty, A, B and P; the exact generics on all three presentations are enumerated (a dense set must contain a member of A and the element b); valuation agreement in M is checked by rank induction for the explicit representative translations; and the example deliberately avoids the general dense-translation theorem. No Choice. No defect.

Sound refutation with the two consistency qualifications kept separate: under external Con(S) with S=ZFC+Con(ZFC), the published no-transitive-model theorem yields a model of Con(ZFC) plus not-TM(ZFC); under external Con(ZFC), second incompleteness with the verified arithmetic and derivability hypotheses forbids ZFC proving Con(ZFC). The semantic CTM theorem is used only conditionally and finite-fragment transfer is not confused with a full CTM. No defect.

Sound refutation with Con(ZF) explicit. Semantically, 2^{<omega} is atomless, the generic filter is new, ordinals are preserved and constructibility absoluteness gives L^{M[G]}=L^M contained in M, so M[G] models V not equal L; formally the extra tag for not-(V=L) is discharged by the fixed atomless/new-generic/ordinal/L-history schemata with primitive-recursive assembly, so Con(ZF) yields Con(ZFC+not-(V=L)), and a ZF proof of V=L would refute that. No CTM is inferred from consistency and ZF is not claimed to prove its own consistency. No defect.
